protection.save_failed: Your choice could not be saved or applied. Check the current selection and try again.

curve.title: Protection over time
curve.description: Enabled effects build in stages as you approach a site's daily time goal.
curve.standard_desc: Adds effects in sequence as you approach your goal.
curve.steep_desc: Starts earlier and builds more quickly.
curve.preview_label: Illustration of the selected protection curve
curve.preview_note: An illustration of the rise. Each effect has its own onset and strength. The final stage stays in place after your goal is reached.
curve.basis: A site goal and usage recording are required. Sites without a goal or recording use the existing fixed behavior. Choose each effect's maximum strength and curve or fixed mode in Tools.
curve.custom: A custom curve is active. Choosing a preset below clears the custom values and applies that preset.

goal_ends.title: When a goal is reached
goal_ends.description: Choose which goals to be reminded about, independently of your time goals.
goal_ends.site_desc: A reminder when each site reaches its daily time goal.
goal_ends.global_desc: A reminder when daily use across protected sites reaches your overall goal.
goal_ends.presentation: Goals currently end with a reminder. Supported feeds first show a readable boundary, then the reminder follows a fresh action to continue. An unverified boundary leaves the reminder waiting.
goal_ends.paused: Goal reminders are selected, but protection or the reminder tool is currently paused. Reminders prepare again after protection is resumed.

principles.title: Overlapping reminders and changed goals
principles.boundary: A reminder waits for a safe boundary that lets you finish the current content. Time expiry alone does not interrupt the flow.
principles.priority: New reminders are selected in this order: overall goal, site goal, periodic reflection. An experience already in progress keeps its place. Only goals actually reached together are combined.
principles.edits: Changing a goal rechecks reminders that have not been delivered. A reminder already delivered is not repeated by editing the goal on the same day.
principles.periodic: Periodic reflection is a separate Barrier choice. Its cadence is independent of goal reminders.

daily_rhythm.title: Start of your day
daily_rhythm.desc: Align daily usage and limits with your routine. The default start time is 04:00.
daily_rhythm.current: When daily usage and limits begin a new day.
daily_rhythm.change_timing: Applies at the next boundary of your current day.
daily_rhythm.pending: Your day will start at {{hour}} from {{date}}.
daily_rhythm.recommendation_desc: Suggested from {{days}} completed days with usage. Your start time changes only when you accept.
daily_rhythm.recommendation_hint: Suggestions appear only when enough usage history indicates a different routine. Your start time never changes automatically.
daily_rhythm.error: Could not load or save your day start setting. Please try again.

zen_render.title: Zen visual quality

zen_render.full_desc: Keep full water and lighting detail.
zen_render.balanced_desc: Keep smooth motion with softer water detail and fewer small effects.
zen_render.low_desc: Lower visual detail and frame rate to reduce power use and heat.
zen_render.error: Could not save visual quality. Please select it again.

access.title: Site Effects

precision.label: 3. Analysis depth
precision.missing: Behavior permission is only requested if you enable precision.

analysis.desc: Reads local patterns for home feedback. No extra browser access is required.
analysis.note: Leave it off if you only want blocking and site effects.
analysis.profile_desc: Start with one of two clear modes. Detailed scope and precision signals are still available in advanced settings.
analysis.profile_rhythm_desc: Summarize domain and time for every site, and use precision behavior signals only inside protected sites.
analysis.profile_small_desc: Start with sites you explicitly protect and keep precision behavior signals off.
analysis.records_desc: Choose which domains can leave local time records.
analysis.records_protected_desc: Record time only for protected sites and their local goals.
analysis.records_all_sites_desc: Record domain and time for every visited site. No behavior details.
analysis.records_off_desc: Do not create domain usage history.
analysis.precision_desc: Choose which activity history to keep from protected sites.
analysis.precision_off_desc: Does not add new activity history or personal learning. Observation needed by protection may continue.
analysis.precision_protected_desc: Allow precision signals only inside protected sites.
analysis.precision_note: Precision can improve explanations and threshold timing, but it asks for higher-resolution local behavior signals.
analysis.excluded_desc: Excluded sites do not contribute new usage records or analysis. Protection settings and existing records are retained. Removing an exclusion applies the current recording scope.

sites.title: Site permissions
sites.desc: Uses Chrome site access so protection can run on managed sites.
sites.runtime_access_desc: Turns page intervention on or off.
sites.hosts_ready: No host permissions are currently missing.

behavior.title: Behavior insights engine
behavior.desc: Experimental. Turn on only if you need CLSE sensing.
behavior.recommendation_desc: Not needed for basic limits and friction.

app_chrome.title: Sidebar

app_chrome.expanded_desc: Show icons and tab names together.
app_chrome.icons_desc: Narrow the sidebar to leave more room for content.

precision_beta.title: Precision Behavior Analysis
precision_beta.desc: Reads more detailed page behavior signals locally than basic usage records. It can improve explanations and thresholds, but should stay an explicit advanced opt-in.
precision_beta.permission_desc: Activity history needs browser permissions to check active use and page navigation.
precision_beta.scope_desc: Choose where precision signals are allowed.
precision_beta.signals_desc: Allow or exclude each signal individually. If the feature is off, no precision signal is recorded.

clse.exclude_1: Page body, search terms, and typed text

navigation.collect_2: Navigation type counters such as address bar, link, and reload
navigation.exclude_1: Full URL paths, query strings, and page titles

security.passcode_configured_desc: The passcode stays on this device and confirms the sensitive actions you choose.
security.passcode_empty_desc: Set a passcode to lock data deletion and app reset.
security.policy_desc: Choose which actions require the passcode and whether protection settings can change.
